entity.description: A named collection of events (WorkEffort, usually WetEvent) through CalendarWorkEffort rows: a user's personal calendar (kind CalkPersonal, ownerPartyId the user's person party; one of them isDefault=Y, made on first use), a shared calendar (CalkShared, ownerPartyId a person or an organization, opened by CalendarShare rows), a resource calendar (CalkResource, a meeting room or equipment schedule) or an external feed (CalkSubscription, with its CalendarSubscription; its events come only from the feed). A calendar grid shows the events of the calendars toggled on plus every event where the user is a WorkEffortParty, so an event needs no calendar to appear. mantle.work.CalendarServices checks access: the owner's person manages, shares give free/busy, view, edit or manage.

field.name: ownerPartyId
field.description: A person (a personal calendar) or an organization

field.name: color
field.description: The calendar's color, a CSS color such as #1e88e5

field.name: timeZone
field.description: The time zone new events and recurrence rules of this calendar use; empty for the user's time zone

field.name: isDefault
field.description: Y on the owner's default personal calendar, where new events go

entity.description: A calendar opened to a user (userId), a user group (userGroupId) or a party (partyId: a person, or an organization for the users whose party belongs to it) with a permission: free/busy (busy times only), view (the events), edit (add, change and remove events) or manage (the calendar itself and its shares). A publish link is a share with a publishToken and none of userId, userGroupId and partyId, view or free/busy only, optionally with a password (passwordHash). Unsharing sets thruDate.

field.name: publishToken
field.description: The secret of a publish link (anyone with the link)

field.name: passwordHash
field.description: The publish link's optional password, hashed

entity.description: The external feed of a subscription calendar (kind CalkSubscription): an iCalendar URL (http, https or webcal) or a provider account (Google, Microsoft 365: later, through OAuth). The fetch job (mantle.work.CalendarServices.fetch#CalendarSubscriptions) reads it every refreshMinutes and writes its events into the calendar; lastFetchStatus is ok or error, with the error's text in lastFetchError.

field.name: lastFetchStatus
field.description: ok or error; empty until the first fetch

entity.description: An event (or another work effort) in a calendar. An event may be in several calendars, and in none.

field.name: davName
field.description: The resource name a CalDAV client stored the event under (mantle.work.CalendarDavServices), when it is not workEffortId.ics

field.name: parentWorkEffortId
field.description: For task/etc breakdown; a move in the work item tree (TaskServices.move#Task) is in the audit log

field.name: rootWorkEffortId
field.description: The root of the tree this is part of (if applicable), like a project

field.name: ownerPartyId
field.description: The party that "owns" the work effort, for production runs producing inventory this will be used as the Asset.ownerPartyId

field.name: sequenceNum
field.description: The rank of a task among the tasks of its parent (or of its project at the top), lowest first, in gaps of 1000 so a move renumbers only when a gap closes

field.name: estimatedPoints
field.description: Story points, in the project's estimate unit, beside the hours of estimatedWorkTime

field.name: healthEnumId
field.description: For a project: on track, at risk or off track, from its latest status update (WorkEffortUpdate)

field.name: isTemplate
field.description: Y for a project kept as a template to copy (ProjectServices.clone#Project), left out of the lists of projects and work

field.name: facilityId
field.description: Where the WorkEffort takes place

field.name: shipmentMethodEnumId
field.description: Mostly for Shipment Load/Ship (WepShipmentShip) purpose, using WorkEffort as a more task and planning oriented approach to a picklist.

field.name: allDayEnd
field.description: Can be null for single day events

field.name: estimatedWorkTime
field.description: Total estimated work time across all parties

field.name: estimatedSetupTime
field.description: Total estimated setup time across all parties

field.name: remainingWorkTime
field.description: Total remaining work time across all parties

field.name: actualWorkTime
field.description: Total actual work time across all parties

field.name: actualSetupTime
field.description: Total actual setup time across all parties

field.name: totalTimeAllowed
field.description: Total work time allowed (budgeted) across all parties

field.name: estimatedWorkDuration
field.description: Estimated work duration in calendar time (see estimatedWorkTime for total worked time across parties)

field.name: actualWorkDuration
field.description: Actual work duration in calendar time (see actualWorkTime for total worked time across parties)

field.name: actualBreakDuration
field.description: Actual break duration in calendar time

field.name: timeUomId
field.description: Time unit for all time and duration fields; defaults to hours (TF_hr)

moqui.basic.StatusFlow.description: Other, more lenient, status transitions for WorkEffort
Development: In Progress, In Review, In Testing, Complete

entity.description: For equipment, inventory, etc needed in the work effort.

field.name: lagDays
field.description: For WeatDependsOn (workEffortId depends on toWorkEffortId, finish to start): the working days between the end of toWorkEffortId and the start of workEffortId

entity.description: Categories for WorkEffort, especially events like iCal/VCALENDAR categories, and the labels of tasks

field.name: colorName
field.description: A color name of the theme's set (blue, teal, amber, ...) for a label's chip

entity.description: A deliverable a work effort hands over; for a milestone (IronStone Projects, design-projects.md §4 MilestoneDetail) its order and whether the client accepted it.

A facility a work effort uses: the inventory origin of a production run, or a meeting room (or another bookable facility) an event books, whose statusId is the booking (WefRequested waits for approval, WefAssigned is booked, WefRequestDenied with the reason in comments); empty for the uses that are not bookings.

field.name: snoozedThruDate
field.description: Hidden from this party's Today until this date (a snooze); the work effort's dates and the other parties' Today stay as they are

field.name: invitationSentDate
field.description: When the last invitation to the event went to this attendee (mantle.work.EventServices.send#EventInvitations)

field.name: invitationDigest
field.description: A digest of the event's name, time, place and recurrence as that invitation had them: a different digest now means the attendee gets an updated invitation

entity.description: A work effort (an activity: a call, email, to-do or meeting) on any record, by the record's full entity name and the value of its single primary key field, for a record type without a join of its own. The own joins (mantle.request.RequestWorkEffort, WikiPageWorkEffort) stay; mantle.work.WorkEffortServices.link#WorkEffortRecord chooses.

The recurrence of an event (or a task) as iCalendar (RFC 5545) has it: the work effort is the series and its dates are the first instance (DTSTART and its duration). rrule is the RRULE value (FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=MO,WE), exdates and rdates the EXDATE and RDATE values (comma separated DATE-TIME or DATE values, as in an ICS file), all read in timeZone (an IANA name; empty for the calendar's or the user's). An instance changed on its own is a WorkEffort linked from the series by WorkEffortAssoc WeatRecurrenceInstance. The framework's ICalendar tool expands the rule; the older WorkEffort.recurStartCron, recurLimit and recurEndDate stay for jobs.

field.name: recurFromCompletion
field.description: Y for a recurring task whose next dates count from the day the last one was completed rather than from its due date

entity.description: A reminder of an event or a task for one of its parties: offsetMinutes before the event's start (a task's due date), by notification on the topic WorkEffortReminder or by email (methodEnumId). The reminder job (mantle.work.EventServices.send#DueReminders) sends it once per instance and sets sentDate; snoozedThruDate holds it back, then sends it again.

field.name: offsetMinutes
field.description: Minutes before the start; 0 at the start

entity.description: A project's own choice of a setting (ProjectServices.store#ProjectSetting); without a row the organization's applies (ProjectServices.get#ProjectSettings): the PartySetting the setting type's optionValue names, a JSON object whose enumCode key holds it.

moqui.basic.Enumeration.description: Modules (the project's tabs on, a comma list)
Work item types offered (WorkEffortPurpose ids, a comma list)
New work items shared with the client (Y or N)
Fixes keywords in commits complete work items (Y or N)
A request completes when its work does (Y or N)
Request types offered (RequestType ids, a comma list)
Merge requests move work items (Y or N)
Hours shared with the client (Y or N)
Time detail on invoices (Y or N)
Repositories shared with the client read only (Y or N)

entity.description: A status update posted on a project: its text is the CommunicationEvent (type StatusUpdate), and the project's healthEnumId follows the latest one.

field.name: clientVisible
field.description: Y when posted for the project's client contacts

entity.description: A plan of a person's time on a project (IronStone Projects, design-projects.md §9 and §15 Allocations): hours a week, or a percent of the person's capacity, from one day to another, on a project or one of its work items. Not an assignment (WorkEffortParty) and not time (TimeEntry). With no partyId it is a placeholder: a project role (and a skill) to be staffed. Requested by a project's manager, then allocated or rejected by one who approves allocations (mantle.work.ResourceServices).

field.name: workEffortId
field.description: The project, or a work item of it

field.name: rootWorkEffortId
field.description: The project (workEffortId itself for a project)

field.name: partyId
field.description: The person; empty for a placeholder to staff

field.name: roleTypeId
field.description: The project role (RgpProject) it fills; a person staffed is added to the project in it

field.name: fromDate
field.description: The first day

field.name: thruDate
field.description: The last day (inclusive)

field.name: allocationPercent
field.description: A percent of the person's capacity, in place of hoursPerWeek

field.name: reviewComments
field.description: The reason of a rejection

entity.description: A request for the approval of a work effort's gate (IronStone Projects, design-projects.md §4 MilestoneDetail and §15 Milestone approval): a milestone that requires approval (its WorkEffortSetting WstApprovalRequired, the approver WstApproverParty) is not reached until one is approved. One per request: requested, then approved, refused or cancelled (a new request after a refusal is a new record). The approver is a party (a manager, or a client contact); the decision is made by a user, the approver's own or one who records it for them (recordedFor Y). The estimate sent for approval is the file workEffortContentId of the project's Estimate milestone (mantle.work.ProjectServices).

field.name: workEffortContentId
field.description: The file approved, as an estimate

field.name: recordedFor
field.description: Y when the user deciding is not the approver's own: a manager recorded the approver's decision

entity.description: A git repository of a project. Commit messages, branch names and tag names in it that name a task of the project are linked to the task, and the project's members may use the repository.
A commit linked to a work effort, usually a task. The summary, author and date are copied from the commit, so a list of them reads no git objects.

field.name: refName
field.description: The branch or tag the commit came on

entity.description: A merge request (the framework's moqui.resource.GitMergeRequest) linked to a work item: by its source branch's name, by a key in its title or description, or by hand (mantle.work.GitServices.link#MergeRequestItems, add#MergeRequestItem). completeOnMerge Y: the item is completed when the merge request merges (complete#MergeRequestItems), from a Closes keyword or the project's WstMergeRequestMoves.
A branch or tag linked to a work effort: a task, or for a tag also a project or milestone. The thruDate is set when the ref is deleted.

field.name: refName
field.description: refs/heads/... or refs/tags/...

field.name: refType
field.description: branch or tag

field.name: objectId
field.description: The commit it named when linked

field.name: partyId
field.description: The party performing work (worker, may be the vendor or work for the vendor)

field.name: vendorPartyId
field.description: The vendor (employer, etc) who pays the worker. With workEffortId (task or project) the party in the Vendor role, with facilityId the party in the Manager role

field.name: clientPartyId
field.description: The client who pays the vendor for bill through. May get through timesheetId, workEffortId (with Customer or CustomerBillTo role), or facilityId (Facility.ownerPartyId)

field.name: hasModifiedRates
field.description: Set to Y when *Rate fields are manually set and not from RateAmount lookups

field.name: rateAmountId
field.description: Client/customer hourly RateAmount reference

field.name: vendorRateAmountId
field.description: Vendor/worker hourly RateAmount reference

field.name: breakHours
field.description: Non-paid break hours e.g. Lunch

field.name: pieceRateAmountId
field.description: Client/customer piece RateAmount reference

field.name: vendorPieceRateAmountId
field.description: Vendor/worker piece RateAmount reference

field.name: facilityId
field.description: Where the work was done; if null and workEffortId is set get from WorkEffort.facilityId
